nodes.title: Survive the Drift
nodes.description: You have awakened in the hostile desert of Aloa. Gather resources and find shelter before nightfall.

nodes.title: The Rusty Boar
nodes.description: You reached a makeshift settlement. A local merchant claims raiders are planning an attack.

nodes.title: Raider Ambush
nodes.description: The raider leader, Krell, has found you. Defeat him to secure the settlement.
